topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: When I found out someone had tattooed my artwork on their skin, I couldn’t help but reflect on the journey it took to get here. Each stroke, each hue, meticulously chosen with a vision that apparently resonated beyond the canvas. It’s one thing to see your work in galleries, lit by the soft glow of museum lights, but it’s another to know that it has become a part of someone’s personal story, inked into their life. The permanence of it, the intimacy, it’s... quite something. I suppose it’s a reminder that art, in its truest form, is an act of sharing, a bridge between the creator and the observer. It’s a dialogue that transcends the ordinary.
